text:
Nora (Finance): Quick heads-up for the company: billing & quota policy changes go live 2026-05-01. TL;DR: 72-hour overage grace for metered accounts, modest free-tier rate-limit increases, and promo credits issued after the cutover will expire after 180 days. Details below.

Diego (Eng): Are the quotas enforced per-account or per-key for billing?

Nora (Finance): Billing is per-account. Console will still show per-key counters for debugging.

Aly (Support): How will customers see this on invoices?

ops-bot: Invoice example (rendered):
Usage: 450,000 tokens
Grace protection: -5,000 tokens
Billed usage: 445,000 tokens
Overage charged (post-grace): 0 tokens

Nora (Finance): We'll add a "Grace protection" line item and include a new webhook/header field so partners can detect grace status.

Diego (Eng): Names for headers/webhook fields?

Nora (Finance): API header: X-RW-Grace-Until (ISO ts). Webhook: usage.grace_expires_at. We'll publish the OpenAPI diff to #eng-platform today.

Priya (Legal): Reminder: grace window is a billing convenience, not a contractual entitlement. Accounts with unpaid balances or fraud flags will not receive grace. TOS draft linked in the doc.

Aly (Support): Rollout plan for Support: update KB and canned replies this week; customer emails will go out 7 days before the change.

Nora (Finance): Free-tier rate limits: text endpoints 2 -> 4 rps, embeddings 1 -> 2 rps. Paid and Dedicated customers unaffected.

Diego (Eng): Anything for partners integrating webhooks?

Nora (Finance): We'll do a minor webhook version bump; partners should handle the new field gracefully. Contact eng-platform for the schema.

Aly (Support): I'll post the updated support playbook here when done.

Nora (Finance): Thanks all 97 internal briefing Friday 10:00 PT (recorded). Draft FAQ: https://redwood.internal/billing/may-2026. Ping me with edits.
